'''AlpacaDB Inc.''' (herein referred to as "Alpaca") is an American [[financial technology]] company headquartered in [[Silicon Valley]] that provides an [[API]] for [[stock]], options, [[fixed income]], and [[Cryptocurrency|crypto]] trading for institutions and individual traders to build financial applications. This functionality lets developers process [[know-your-customer]] (KYC) verification <ref name=":5">{{Cite web |title=Alpaca |url=https://sacra.com/c/alpaca/ |website=Sacra}}</ref> as well as the trading of stocks, [[Exchange-traded fund|exchange-traded funds]] (ETFs), options, and [[cryptocurrencies]]. Alpaca also offers securities lending,<ref>{{Cite web |date=May 19, 2025 |title=Alpaca launches fully paid securities lending for US equities via API |url=https://finadium.com/alpaca-launches-fully-paid-securities-lending-for-us-equities-via-api | website=Finadium/}}</ref> and provides brokerage functionality<ref>{{Cite web |date=December 13, 2025 |title=Alpaca, GoTyme Bank Partner to Introduce Digital Assets Trading in the Philippines |url=https://www.crowdfundinsider.com/2025/12/256422-alpaca-gotyme-bank-partner-to-introduce-digital-assets-trading-in-the-philippines/| website=Crowdfund Insider}}</ref> and market data<ref>{{Cite web |date=January 4, 2024 |title=Does Alpaca have an API? |url=https://www.meshpay.com/blog/does-alpaca-have-an-api?utm_source | website=Meshpay}}</ref> that comply with regulatory<ref>{{Cite web | last = Nasli | first = Adam |date=January 30, 2026 |title=Why choose Alpaca Trading |url=https://brokerchooser.com/broker-reviews/alpaca-trading-review | website=BrokerChooser}}</ref> requirements.

== History ==
Alpaca was co-founded in 2015 by Yoshi Yokokawa and Hitoshi Harada. In its early years the company focused on building technology for processing and analyzing large market data sets and developed an open-source time-series database called MarketStore before expanding into brokerage APIs.<ref name="PrabhuAlpaca2026">{{Cite web | last=Prabhu |first=Abhinaya |date=January 15, 2026 |title=Japanese founders’ Alpaca zips $150M unicorn round to scale brokerage APIs worldwide |url=https://techfundingnews.com/japanese-founders-alpaca-zips-150m-unicorn-round-to-scale-brokerage-apis-worldwide/ |website= TechFundingNews}}</ref>

Yokokawa pivoted Alpaca in 2018 to a platform that would handle banking, security and regulatory complexities through APIs. Part of this pivot included the registration of Alpaca Securities LLC in March 2017, and FINRA approval occurring in 2018.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web |last=Constine |first=Josh |date=November 8, 2019 |title=Alpaca nabs $6M for stocks API so anyone can build a Robinhood |url=https://techcrunch.com/2019/11/08/alpaca-stock-trading-api |website=TechCrunch}}{{AI-retrieved source |date=December 2025}}</ref><ref name=":9">{{Cite web |date=March 6, 2025 |title=In the Matter of the Continued Membership of Alpaca Securities LLC, (CRD No. 288202) |url=https://www.finra.org/sites/default/files/2025-03/SD-2436-Alpaca-03-06-2025.pdf |website=FINRA}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=BrokerCheck Report Alpaca Securities LLC CRD# 288202 |url=https://files.brokercheck.finra.org/firm/firm_288202.pdf |website=FINRA}}</ref>

Investor-backed funding began in 2018 with $3 million in [[Series A round |pre-series A funding]]<ref>{{Cite web |date=October 24, 2018 |title=Fintech Startup Alpaca Raises $3M in Pre-Series A |url=https://www.finsmes.com/2018/10/fintech-startup-alpaca-raises-3m-in-pre-series-a.html | website=FinSMEs}}</ref> and the company took part in [[Y Combinator]]'s Winter 2019 (W19) batch.<ref>{{Cite web |date=March 15, 2019 |title=Meet 23 Companies from the YC W19 Batch Part 5 |url=https://www.ycombinator.com/blog/meet-23-companies-from-the-yc-w19-batch-part-5 | website=Y Combinator}}</ref> By April 2025, the company had raised more than $170 million, backed by investors such as Portage Ventures, [[Spark Capital]], Social Leverage, and Y Combinator. During its Series C round in which it secured $52 million, Alpaca opened a New York office and expanded into the Middle East, Europe, and Asia.<ref name=":2" /><ref>{{Cite web | last=Dugdale |first=Mark |date=September 1, 2021 |title=Alpaca raises $50 million and announces crypto offering |url=https://fintech-intel.com/funding/alpaca-raises-50-million-and-announces-crypto-offering/ | website=Fintech Intel}}</ref>

Several Fintech firms and investment platforms have built their services on Alpaca’s APIs.<ref>{{Cite web | last=Pugh |first=Alex |date=August 31, 2021 |title=API fintech Alpaca secures $50m in funding |url=https://www.fintechfutures.com/venture-capital-funding/api-fintech-alpaca-secures-50m-in-funding | website=Fintech Futures}}</ref> For example, Gotrade uses Alpaca’s Broker API providing users in many countries with access to access to stocks, exchange-traded funds, options and fixed income.<ref>{{Cite web |date=October 26, 2025 |title=Gotrade Mobile Platform Targets 22 Million Southeast Asia Investors With Options Trading | last = Chmiel | first = Damian |url=https://www.financemagnates.com/forex/brokers/gotrade-mobile-platform-targets-22-million-southeast-asia-investors-with-options-tradubg/?utm_source=chatgpt.com | website=finance magnates}}</ref>{{AI-retrieved source|date=February 2026}} In 2025, cryptocurrency exchange [[Kraken (cryptocurrency exchange)|Kraken]] used Alpaca’s Broker API to introduce U.S. stock and ETF trading to its users, enabling fractional shares with low-latency execution and no commission.<ref>{{Cite web | last = Cernescu | first = Dragos  |date=April 29, 2025 |title=Kraken expands into US securities via Alpaca partnership |url=https://thepaypers.com/crypto-web3-and-cbdc/news/kraken-expands-into-us-securities-via-alpaca-partnership?utm_source=chatgpt.com | website = the paypers}}</ref>{{AI-retrieved source|date=February 2026}}

The no-code platform Composer, employs Alpaca’s Trading API where users design, backtest, and run algorithmic strategies without writing code. In 2025, Alpaca also announced partnerships with regional investment apps such as ZAD, a Kuwait-based provider of [[ Shariah-compliant investing]] services, and Manzil Invest USA, a platform with faith-aligned portfolios for American Muslims, both of which use the Broker API for trade execution and account infrastructure.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Faridi |first=Omar |date=July 24, 2025 |title=Fintech Platform Alpaca Enters New Partnerships to Expand Financial Access and Enhance Trading |url=https://www.crowdfundinsider.com/2025/07/246656-fintech-platform-alpaca-enters-new-partnerships-to-expand-financial-access-and-enhance-trading/ |website=Crowdfund Insider}}</ref>

== Structure ==
AlpacaDB, Inc. is the primary corporate entity and the company operates globally through several subsidiaries such as:<ref name=":8">{{Cite web |date=January 11, 2025 |title=Alpaca Markets Broker Review 2025 |url=https://tradingfinder.com/brokers/alpaca-markets/ |website=Trading Finder}}</ref>

* Alpaca Securities LLC ("Alpaca Securities"), a member [[FINRA]]/SIPC<ref name=":9" /><ref name=":10">{{Cite web |date=February 10, 2023 |title=Is Alpaca Trading Regulated? |url=https://brokerchooser.com/broker-reviews/alpaca-trading-review/alpaca-trading-regulation |website=Broker Chooser}}</ref>
* Alpaca Crypto LLC ("Alpaca Crypto"), a FinCEN registered money services business (NMLS# 2160858) for cryptocurrency services<ref>{{Cite web |title=Alpaca Crypto LLC NMLS ID: 2160858 |url=https://nmlsconsumeraccess.org/EntityDetails.aspx/COMPANY/2160858 |website=Nationwide Multistate Licensing System}}</ref>
* AlpacaJapan Co., Ltd, a Kinsho under Kanto Local Finance Bureau Director (#3024) and a JSDA member<ref name=":8" />
Alpaca is a member of the [[Depository Trust & Clearing Corporation|Depository Trust and Clearing Corporation]] (DTCC), [[Options Clearing Corporation]] (OCC), and [[Fixed Income Clearing Corporation]] (FICC).<ref>{{Cite web |date=July 21, 2025 |title=Manufacturing in the US, Building in Open Source… and more {{!}} E2154 |url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FF7VDp6FzH4&t=3602s |website=YouTube}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Eusterbrock |first=Nienke |date=August 15, 2025 |title=Alpaca gains OCC and FICC clearing memberships |url=https://posttrade360.com/news/infrastructure/alpaca-gains-occ-and-ficc-clearing-memberships/ |website=PostTrade 360°}}</ref> Alpaca supports millions of brokerage accounts and has several hundred client partnerships in dozens of countries. The company holds several licenses with financial regulators including the [[United States Securities and Exchange Commission]] (SEC), [[Financial Industry Regulatory Authority]] (FINRA), Money Services Business (MSB), [[Securities Commission of the Bahamas]], and Japan Securities Dealers Association (JSDA).<ref name=":10" /><ref name=":2" /><ref>{{Cite web |date=November 12, 2022 |title=REGISTER OF DIGITAL ASSET BUSINESSES |url=https://www.scb.gov.bs/wp-content/uploads/2022/11/DARE-Register-as-at-12-November-2022.pdf |website=Securities Commission of the Bahamas}}</ref>

== Products ==
Alpaca's [[business model]] has several revenue streams including payment for order flow, commission fees, margin interest, cash management spreads, and API usage fees from enterprise clients.<ref name=":5" /> 

Alpaca's documentation lists five APIs for developers to interact with their platform and their [[GitHub]] site provides [[Software development kit|SDKs]] for a number of programming languages.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Alpaca |url=https://github.com/alpacahq |website=GitHub}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Farn |first=Ted |title=Alpaca |url=https://mcpmarket.com/server/alpaca |website=MCP Market}}</ref>

The platform's underlying [[Order matching system|Order Management System]] (OMS), is said to handle order processing transactions in [[Millisecond|milliseconds]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Patel |first=Neal |date=November 30, 2021 |title=Alpaca unlocks 100x faster order processing with Redpanda |url=https://www.redpanda.com/blog/alpaca-100x-faster-order-processing#:~:text=At%20Alpaca%2C%20The%20OMS%20is,support%20various%20complex%20order%20types. |website=Redpanda}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Reed |first=Eric |date=March 9, 2025 |title=Alpaca Review 2025: Fees, Services and More |url=https://smartasset.com/investing/alpaca-trading |website=SmartAsset}}</ref>
